notes.title: Апдейт лив
notes.content:
Те, у кого Steam на русском - могут уже начать играть. 

Добавлены:

Уровни:

-Лес. 
Сидишь с ноутбуком на коленях у костра
-Ванная
Лежишь в ванне с планшетом( не повторять в реальности, опасно для жизни)
-Орбита земли. У игрока 3 монитора.
-Космическая станция.  Лежишь в кровати в видом на землю и спутники.

Сайты:
Анимешная борода для девушек теперь вас приятно удивит. Пробовать из уровня Кибер-сычевальня.

Tralevator.to - возможность менять уровни из интернета. Платно.


Игра поделена на 2 режима:
Киберсычевальня и Кампания
В кампании ничего нет, отличия в том, что уровни доступны только за деньги. В будущем будет что-то еще.

notes.title: Update is live!
notes.content:
Update is live!
Most of promised features are implemented, including language settings, a few characters, save/load game and there is one more beta-stage- level: toilet
Other things are to come in a few days as there was a bug and I had to redo a few things

Currently I am working on implementing some keyboard typing animations that will press exactly what you press on the real life keyboard, so keep in mind that it will also be added at some stage
 
This month I will be adding 1 photorealistic level: Moon
Also, Toilet level overhaul is coming as well with some photorealistic models

Other levels are also may be added this month, but they will be in beta

This game is going to be huge

notes.title: April 1 update will be live on April 3 PST
notes.content: We are still working on polishing the update, please expect it to be released within 24 hours, sorry for the delay

notes.title: April 1 update is on it's way
notes.content:
Hi, so a lot things have been finished and the update is in the QA stage

A total list of things that will be added:

1. 6 characters to choose from. 
2. You can choose gender and personality of your character (currently there are 2 genders, about 30 new to come in the final version, subject to change tho)
3. In-game language settings
4. More purchasable furniture
5. In-game clothing shop
6. Web-site to change levels
7. Room skin options
8. Save/load game! Your character and their money can be saved! 
9. Praying gives more money
10. Better UI
11. Splash screen overhaul
12. Music
13. 5 new achievements
14. A few minor animation patches, a huge animation overhaul is coming in May. Everything will be very immersive.
15. Ability to rewrite or delete the save file


All characters will consequently get custom voices, some unique behavior and probably different room levels to match their personality
There will be a lot of unique comments based on your save game, they won't repeat.
Soon Steam Cloud saves will be also enabled
A lot of new levels to come:

Confirmed levels are:

-Moon
-Beach
-Internet-cafe
-Forest camping side. You will be using a laptop instead of regular PC.



[i]Just want to let you know that I want my games to be on a high quaility, right now it's maybe just a unique and funny simulator with easter eggs, but I want it to become something more, and I am going to invest a lot of time on getting it onto a high quality level, extremely immersive Internet Simulator, a one-off solution for cyber-space internet browsing. I will do everything to make a great project so that the people will get into the atmosphere of browsing the internet from cyber-space and see it the way it is in my mind. [/i]
